steps: Assess insurance market for derivatives assessment & diagnostics using IAIS ICP compliance assessment
Design risk-based supervision framework with solvency and conduct requirements
Implement with actuarial standards, reserving requirements, and market conduct rules
Deploy insurance market development with new products and distribution channels
Measure through penetration, solvency ratios, and claims settlement performance
treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — insurance penetration rate using insurance statistics. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — insurance penetration rate measured annually. Target: premium-to-GDP above 5%. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against IAIS global benchmark. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — insurance penetration rate trending toward above 7%. Escalate if <above 3% floor. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit using IAIS Insurance Core Principles. Report to Insurance Supervisor.
treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 30 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >7 consecutive days, escalate to a derivatives and structured products specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. If the intervention produces adverse unintended effects at any point, pause implementation and request specialist review within 7 days.
